frontier_world_model_summary: AI is moving from conversation and content generation toward systems that call tools, coordinate with other agents, access enterprise systems, and initiate delegated commercial actions.
monetization_path: Agent Action Legitimacy Audit / black-box review
strategic_bottleneck: Y* must turn its deep trust/action philosophy into one buyer-visible demo that proves agent action legitimacy without fake validation or external effects.
what_ceo_should_focus_on_next: A no-send black-box demo packet for one concrete agent action.
A simple market story: intent to action to evidence to receipt to learning.
what_ceo_should_stop_doing: Stop treating readiness review as the whole story.
Stop treating provider/live work as the default next milestone.
Stop generating internal-only gates that do not make the trust/action layer visible.
